# MBBS Abroads - FEFU General Medicine Admission Guidance

> Dedicated consultancy portal for Indian students and families applying to Far Eastern Federal University (FEFU) in Vladivostok, Russia for General Medicine (MBBS equivalent).

## Overview & Key Information
- **University**: Far Eastern Federal University (FEFU / ДВФУ)
- **Location**: Russky Island, Vladivostok, Primorsky Krai, Russian Federation
- **Faculty / School**: School of Medicine and Life Sciences
- **Program**: General Medicine (Code: 31.05.01)
- **Duration**: 6 Years (Full-Time)
- **Medium of Instruction**: English
- **Primary Website**: https://mbbsabroads.com
- **Official FEFU Portal**: https://study.dvfu.ru / https://dvfu.ru

## Core Services
1. **Admission Application Guidance**: Verification of 10th/12th marksheets, NEET qualification status, and entrance exam preparation (Biology & Chemistry).
2. **Document Legalization & Translation**: Support with notarized Russian translations, Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) apostille, and university document submission.
3. **Visa & Travel Assistance**: Guidance for Russia student visa application, invitation letter tracking, flight routes from India to Vladivostok, and airport pickup.
4. **Hostel & Campus Onboarding**: Hostel allocation support in FEFU Russky Island dormitories (2-room suites, gym, Indian mess availability, 24/7 security).

## Key Facts & Compliance
- **NMC / FMGL Compliance**: FEFU General Medicine curriculum aligns with National Medical Commission (NMC) Foreign Medical Graduate Licentiate (FMGL) guidelines 2021 (6-year English track + internship + registration eligibility).
- **NEET Requirement**: Qualifying score in NEET-UG (in the year of admission or preceding 2 years) is mandatory for Indian students intending to practice in India.
- **Hostel Cost**: Campus accommodation starts from approx. 3,800 RUB / month (~INR 5,100 / month).
- **Entrance Examination**: Basic online entry tests in Biology and Chemistry administered by FEFU.
